summary: Full backend + frontend testing of AI Dermatologist. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass (signup happy/duplicate/invalid-email/short-password, login ok/wrong, /auth/me ok/invalid/missing, /analyze auth+structured JSON with real skin image, request-activation auth/ok, /activation-tool HTML with sha256+device input, key-parity AAAA-BBBB-CCCC-DDDD hex format). Frontend (mobile web viewport 390x844): full signup -> Home flow works; TrialBanner shows 7-Day Free Trial with live D/H/M/S countdown + Activate chip; New Scan FAB, About tab, key icon and history-empty render correctly; Activate screen shows Device ID card, GCash QR (SVG), Send Device ID button (backend request-activation returns 'sent' -> UI: "Request sent — we'll send your key soon"); Invalid activation key -> inline error 'Invalid activation key for this device.'; Valid HMAC-derived key -> activates device, redirects to Home, banner switches to 'Device Activated / Full access unlocked'. Backend and frontend HMAC parity is identical (backend Python make_activation_key vs js-sha256 in device.ts).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 400-line file; still readable but growing modules (auth, analyze, activation, email) could be split as features are added.
Signup returning 201 with an access_token is fine, but consider adding rate limiting on /auth/signup and /auth/login (currently unlimited).

request_activation records the request even when EMAIL_KEY/ADMIN_EMAIL are missing; response returns status='sent' with emailed=false which is slightly confusing (status still says 'sent' when no email is sent because both keys are absent). Minor UX/logging only — currently both keys are configured so emailed=true was observed.
seed_data_creation: Each test signup creates a fresh TEST_-prefixed user via /api/auth/signup; UI test creates one testui_<ts>@example.com user per run. No manual seed required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web preview logs out on every session (secure storage = localStorage) and generates a new Device ID; do full signup -> activate flow in a single browser session. Login/signup buttons are Pressables — use page.get_by_text('Create account', exact=True).last / get_by_text('Log in', exact=True).last rather than get_by_role('button'). Camera capture is not testable on web; use gallery upload path if capture flow needs testing. Real skin image at /tmp/test_img.jpg (Unsplash dermatology photo) works for /api/analyze and returns valid Gemini 3.1 Pro JSON in ~10s.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no failing tests. All manual assumptions from main agent verified independently.
